column1: # kb-verify guard matrix. Tab-separated, 11 columns, "-" = absent/none.
#   @NL@ newline, @TAB@ tab, @EMPTY@ empty string (field present but empty).
# env flags (comma-separated): JQMISSING NOREALPATH CRASH NODECISION NOPLUGINROOT
# expect: allow (empty stdout, exit 0) | deny (one line of JSON, reason starts with "kb-verify:").
# reason-substring: case-insensitive substring the deny reason must contain, or "-".
# Edit is never one of the three allow branches (they are Write-only), and a
# path ending in "/" names a directory, so the guard decides on the same
# byte string the tool would act on.
# ---- group 6: unresolvable cwd cannot silently disarm (hardening probe F1) --
# A deleted payload cwd falls back to the hook process's own directory; when the
# session is still identifiably inside a KB (KB_VERIFY_CONFIG pins it) the guard
# stays armed instead of failing open.
